observations: Photo 0: one desktop photocopier on a table, still wrapped in clear plastic film.
White and grey body with a scanner lid on top, a control panel with buttons and a small display at front right, output tray in the middle and one paper cassette at the bottom.
Red 'SHARP' logo on the front cover below the output area; the model text under it is too small to read.
Exterior looks clean with no visible cracks, though the plastic film could hide scratches or yellowing.
Watermark 'FRANCIS ODETOLA' across the front; this is the seller's mark.
Machine is not switched on; no counter screen, test copy, drum or toner is shown.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a desktop copier with scanner lid, but nothing shows print or scan functions working.
Photo 0 shows a clean exterior, though under plastic film that may hide marks.
No counter screen or printed counter report is shown.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No photo of the drum, toner cartridge or a receipt.
No clip of the machine feeding and copying.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or copy at all.
risks.proof: Clip of the copier switched on, making several copies from the glass, showing the output sheets.

risks.risk: Page count may be far higher than claimed, meaning worn rollers and fuser.
risks.proof: Photo of the total counter on the display or a printed counter report.

risks.risk: Drum and toner may be old or near empty, giving faint or streaked copies.
risks.proof: Photo of a copy of a full black page and a text page, plus a photo of the drum and toner inside.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new drum and toner

risks.risk: Model unknown, so print, scan and network functions and A3 support are not confirmed.
risks.proof: Close photo of the model name on the front and the rating plate on the back.
risks.if_unproven: as the most basic Sharp desktop copier, copy only

risks.risk: Paper feeding may jam from worn pickup rollers.
risks.proof: Clip of ten copies feeding from the cassette without a jam.

proof_requests: Clip of the copier switched on and making several copies, showing the output.
Photo of the total counter on the display or a counter printout.
Close photo of the model name on the front and the rating plate on the back.
Photo inside the front door showing the drum and toner.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a Sharp desktop multifunction copier, readable by its front logo, so it can be priced at its worst case as a basic Sharp desktop copier, not working, with high count and worn drum, until the counter and a copying clip are shown.
